plugins.Author: Knightmore
plugins.Name: Henchman
plugins.Description:
Your personal Henchman doing all the heavy lifting for you!

- A/B Rank Farmer
- Hunt Logs
- Hunt Bills
- Retainer Creation
- Character Creation
- Multi Account Trading
- Multicharacter Ocean Fishing Cycler
- Chocobokeeps
and more to come.
plugins.Changelog:
On A Boat:
- Replaced AutoHook with WahTools Feesh. No presets required anymore!
- Feesh now handles bait purchases, repairs, travel, boarding, and fishing.
- Added Indigo/Ruby route selection and AutoRetainer/WahTools discard options.
- Added a reorderable manual character list: one character stays logged in, multiple characters cycle each voyage.

Bump On A Log:
- Added character cycling with individual gearset selection and recommended gear.
- Improved Grand Company promotion dungeon handoffs and combat cleanup.

On Your Mark:
- Added select/deselect-all buttons per expansion.
- Fixed expansion matching across game languages (Chinese could work now).

Testy Trader:
- Added drag-and-drop ordering for the manual character list.

Movement / Combat:
- Improved death recovery during movement and combat.
- Fixed movement stalls while handling attacking enemies.
- Prevented mounting attempts when riding is unavailable or mounting is disabled.
